page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Above it: a printer's ornament and a rule. Then the line "L. B. S." set centred. Below that, the body of text, with a large initial E. A printer's emblem sits at the top right beside the greeting. A library stamp overlaps the lower right and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: EXhibemus heîc Tibi, BENE-VOLE LECTOR, Johannis Morini aliorumq; Clarissimo-rum Virorum, de republ. literaria, in Orientalibus & Philologia S. præcipuè, immortaliter merito-rũ, DISSERTATIONES EPISTO-LICAS, quibus ANTIQUITATES ECCLESIÆ ORIENTALIS haud leviter enucleavére. Publici juris primùm factæ sunt Londini, reper-tæ inter libros R.P. Ameloti, Con-gregationis Oratorii Presbyteri, post illius obitum, & ex ipsismet autographis fideliter editæ. Cùm autem ex his insignem in rem li-terariam redundare utilitatem persuasum habeamus, nec exem-plaria apud nos adeò sint freqven-tia, operæ pretium visum fuit, præ-

page.notes: The large initial E is joined to "Xhibemus", printed as "EXhibemus". The printed "persvasum" is written "persuasum" with u for v. "qvibus" and "ANTIQVITATES" are written with u for v. The last line ends with "præ-" and the rest of that word is hidden under the library stamp. The printer's emblem at the top right is an ornament and is not transcribed. The library stamp and the dark smudge at the top are not transcribed.
